The '''Brotherhood of Cognizance''' was a monastic order of the [[Naboo religion|Naboo faith system]] during the last few centuries of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
The Brotherhood of Cognizance was founded many centuries before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. There seems to have been many brothers at the time of the colonization of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], but their number grew smaller and smaller through the centuries, until they were considered an arcane order and mostly forgotten. By the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they resided in a mountain sanctuary, and were made up of approximately twenty brothers. [[Maxiron Agolerga/Legends|Maxiron Agolerga]], the order's [[Pontifex/Legends|Pontifex]], performed the [[Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala/Legends|secret wedding]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|maxironagolerga|Agolerga, Pontifex Maxiron}}</ref>

The Brotherhood focused on discipline and the accumulation and study of knowledge. They were a contemplative order, worshiping art in all its forms, such as poetry, music, paintings and aesthetics. They used to celebrate rites while wearing purple garments.<ref name="Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
The name ''Cognizance'' may be a play on words with the adjective [http://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/aware cognizant]; defined by Webster's dictionary as "a knowledge of something; especially through personal experience". Synonyms include ''mindful(ness)'' and ''aware(ness)''.
